# meshd

> MeshTransit node daemon written in Go.

## Read first

- README.md: scope and build instructions
- docs/architecture.md: component and compatibility boundaries
- docs/security-model.md: threat model, controls, and release gates
- AGENTS.md: mandatory instructions for coding agents

## Core invariants

- A non-empty profile store has exactly one active profile.
- Multiple network views are never merged in the client.
- The client never chooses or sends a network identifier.
- Public API, command, path, and log names use MeshTransit terminology.
- Compatibility code stays isolated under internal adapters and is pinned to reviewed versions.
